hero.title: How to use the solutions
hero.intro: Seven steps to find an adaptation recipe, understand it and take it to your territory. Provisional copy, pending the design team's texts.

steps.title: Search
steps.body: Type what you need in the explorer: a risk, a sector or a territory. Filters narrow the results.

steps.title: Compare
steps.body: Select several solutions and look at them together to see what they share and where they differ.

steps.title: Group by bioregion
steps.body: Place the solutions in their bioregion to find experiences close to your context.

steps.title: Read the recipe
steps.body: Each solution is a recipe of 15 components: the context, how it was done and what it achieved.

steps.title: Talk to the documents
steps.body: Ask the solution's documents what you cannot find on the sheet.

steps.title: Save to a board
steps.body: Pin the solutions that matter and gather them on a board to revisit or share.

steps.title: Create a presentation
steps.body: Generate a presentation from your board to explain it to your team or your community.
